selic.title: Selic (target)
selic.msg: With Selic at this level, your reserves may yield more in conservative investments. It's worth reviewing where your money sits.

ipca.title: IPCA (monthly)
ipca.msg: IPCA measures the monthly price increase. Compare it with your spending trend to see if you're above or below inflation.

usd.title: US Dollar
usd.msg: The dollar can affect international purchases and foreign-currency subscriptions. Watch it before closing the bill.

eur.title: Euro
eur.msg: The euro affects trips and purchases in Europe. If it rises, plan ahead before buying tickets or booking stays.

radar.explainSelic: <bold>Selic:</bold> the economy's base interest rate. It influences savings, CDB, Treasury yields and the cost of credit.
radar.explainIpca: <bold>IPCA:</bold> the official inflation index. Shows how much prices rose this month — useful to compare with your own spending trend.
radar.explainCurr: <bold>Dollar and Euro:</bold> used in international purchases, foreign-currency subscriptions and trips.
radar.disclaimer: Values here are informational only. Nothing on this screen is investment advice.
